recognize_zh: 高倍小腸絨毛的固有層與上皮內，被大量中型、核不規則有角、染色深的非典型淋巴球浸潤，並侵入表面上皮造成上皮空泡化，呈上皮親和性（epitheliotropism），支持腸道 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Lamina propria expanded by a dense infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, angulated hyperchromatic nuclei with small amounts of pale cytoplasm
Numerous atypical lymphocytes infiltrating the surface epithelium (epitheliotropism)
Congested capillaries; plasma cells and eosinophils not prominent
describe_en: High-power section of small-intestinal mucosa shows villi whose lamina propria is expanded by a dense infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated hyperchromatic nuclei and scant pale cytoplasm. Numerous similar cells infiltrate the surface epithelium, which appears vacuolated and disorganized. Congested capillaries are present, and inflammatory cells are not prominent. Findings are consistent with involvement by an intestinal T-cell lymphoma, such as enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma; immunostains for CD3, CD4, CD8, CD56, CD30 and cytotoxic markers are recommended to confirm and subtype.

ddx.vs: MEITL cells are more monotonous, medium-sized with pale cytoplasm and are typically CD8+ CD56+, lacking celiac background; IHC separates it.

ddx.dx: Celiac disease or refractory celiac disease
ddx.vs: Celiac disease has increased intraepithelial lymphocytes that are small and cytologically bland without expansion of the lamina propria by atypical cells.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Indolent T-LPD consists of small bland lymphocytes in the lamina propria with little epitheliotropism and a low Ki-67 index.
NK/T-cell lymphoma shows angiocentric necrosis and is EBER positive, whereas EATL is EBV negative.
